brief:
Israel killed a security official and members of his family in northern Gaza, Middle East Eye reported, marking the second deadly Israeli strike targeting security personnel in the territory. The killing occurred as the United Nations warned of a "real threat" to Palestinian existence.

The strike took place amid ongoing military operations in Gaza. The UN statement pointed to escalating concerns over the humanitarian and demographic consequences of the conflict in the Palestinian territory.

title: Israel kills Gaza security official and family in second attack on personnel
